description: Writes to a remote service. Starts a WalletConnect session and renders a scannable QR (ASCII + PNG). RECOMMENDED signer — the phone signs and broadcasts, so no private key touches this machine. Poll dexe_wc_status until `connected`. A hot DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY keeps signing precedence.

chainId.description: Chain to request in the session namespace. Defaults to the MCP's default chain.

name: dexe_wc_connect
title: Connect a wallet by QR
